se.slashblade.wither_edge.desc:
If the player's current experience level is below the required level, the player receives Wither II for 5 seconds.
If the player's current experience level meets the requirement, the attack target receives Wither II for 5 seconds.
slash_art.slashblade.judgement_cut.desc: The user takes a small step back while summoning a spherical entity at the crosshair, dealing multiple instances of magic damage to enemies within its range.
slash_art.slashblade.sakura_end.desc: Unleashes two powerful slashes in the direction the user is facing.
slash_art.slashblade.void_slash.desc: The user holds the Slash Blade before them, slowly unsheathes it for a wide horizontal sweep, and deals massive magic damage to enemies in the area upon sheathing the blade.
slash_art.slashblade.circle_slash.desc: The user performs a 360-degree horizontal slash centered on themselves, dealing 4 hits of physical damage.
slash_art.slashblade.drive_vertical.desc: The user performs an Iai (quick-draw) slash forward, releasing a Phantom Blade during the strike that deals magic damage to enemies in its path.
slash_art.slashblade.drive_horizontal.de: The user performs a slash forward, releasing a Phantom Blade during the strike that deals magic damage to enemies in its path.
slash_art.slashblade.wave_edge.desc: The user performs an Iai (quick-draw) slash forward, releasing multiple Phantom Blades during the strike that deal magic damage multiple times to enemies in their path.
slash_art.slashblade.piercing.desc: After a brief charge, the user thrusts forward, dealing physical damage to enemies in the path. If released via the 'Quick Charge' technique, the user will instead perform a short-distance thrust immediately.
slash_art.slashblade_addon.rapid_blister: The user performs a slash forward, and upon completion, releases multiple Summoned Swords in the facing direction. These swords deal magic damage upon hitting enemies.
slash_art.slashblade_addon.spiral_edge.d: The user performs a spiral-shaped slash around themselves, dealing multiple hits of physical damage.
slash_art.slashblade_addon.gale_swords.d: The user performs an Iai (quick-draw) slash forward, and upon completion, releases multiple explosive Summoned Swords in the facing direction. These swords explode on impact, dealing magic damage to enemies.
slash_art.slashblade_addon.water_drive.d: The user performs a slash forward, releasing a Phantom Blade during the strike that deals high magic damage to enemies in its path.
slash_art.slashblade_addon.fire_spiral.d: The user performs a spiral-shaped slash around themselves, dealing multiple hits of physical damage. The blade trails are fixed to red.
slash_art.slashblade_addon.lighting_swor: The user performs a slash forward, and upon completion, releases Summoned Swords imbued with lightning effects in the facing direction. These swords deal magic damage to enemies upon impact.
slash_art.ak.bloodsucking_sickle.desc: The user unleashes five slashes directly forward. Each hit restores 7% of the user's health.
slash_art.ak.dragon.desc: The user performs a slash forward, releasing a tongue of fire during the strike that ignites enemies in the path and deals high magic damage.
slash_art.ak.fate.desc: The user throws this blade. If it hits a target, the blade is sacrificed to deal ultra-high multiplier magic damage and apply the Wither effect.
slash_art.ak.fire_slash.desc: The user performs a slash forward, releasing a flame slash that deals magic damage to enemies.
slash_art.ak.immortal.desc: Grants the user Resistance IV and Strength VII for 7 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
slash_art.ak.king.desc: Inflicts Slowness III and Weakness III on the target for 15 seconds, and grants the user Resistance III.
slash_art.ak.king_fire.desc: The user performs a slash forward, bursting flames in all directions during the strike to ignite enemies.
slash_art.ak.liulifan_city.desc: Creates a micro-domain around the user that can block damage up to 3 times the base damage of this blade.
slash_art.ak.ruins.desc: Expands a zone centered on the target entity. All entities within the area take multiple hits of damage and are inflicted with Weakness.
slash_art.ak.shiva_dance.desc: Creates a medium-sized domain centered on the user. After a long charge, it devastates all creatures within the domain. Upon completion, the player's health is reduced to 2 hearts (1 HP).
slash_art.ak.the_emperor_of_ice.desc: Creates a medium-sized domain centered on the user, freezing all creatures except the user within the range. Frozen creatures take 1.3x damage for 10 seconds.
slash_art.ak.the_wrath_of_indra.desc: Fires multiple Sky Swords, striking hit entities with thunder.
slash_art.ak.time_zero.desc: Grants the user Speed V and Haste V for 10 seconds. Immobilizes surrounding creatures during this time.
slash_art.ak.windy_eyes.desc: Generates a wind circle around the user, pulling in nearby creatures and dealing continuous damage.
slashblade.koseki.desc: Place the Anonymity -Nameless- on a Blade Stand and expose it to the explosion generated by a Wither. The Nameless blade will absorb the Wither's power and transform into the Koseki Odachi.
